La red de coautoría es no dirigida. El g: The coauthorship network is undirected. Degree counts distinct coauthors; strength sums shared works. Displayed indicators are recalculated for the active selection. Betweenness uses unweighted shortest paths and is normalized. Weighted eigenvector centrality is calculated only within the largest component. Communities use Louvain with resolution 1 and seed 42. These results describe the observed corpus and are not prestige rankings.
